# dsh-plugin-doctor

> Health checks for DeepSeek Harness: plugin manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install verification, a model-callable `plugin_check` tool, profile host-shadowing detection, and environment diagnostics. Implements the `dsh plugin check` idea from RFC #1629 and the `dsh doctor` idea from discussion #1719.

## Key facts

- Modes: CLI (`node lib/bin.js` / `dsh-plugin-doctor`) and plugin shell (`dsh plugin add`, agent calls `plugin_check`)
- Flags: `--build`, `--full`, `--json`, `--profile <dir>` (host-shadow tripwire), `--env` (node/pnpm/dsh PATH, port 3080)
- Checks: manifest, patch, entry, files, build, pack+install+config, profile-shadow, env
- Verification: 12 unit tests; packaged plugin-shell smoke; doctor self-check; CI green

## Key files

- src/index.ts — core checks + checkProfileShadowing
- src/env.ts — environment diagnostics
- src/plugin.ts — plugin shell with `plugin_check` tool
- src/bin.ts — CLI entry
